name: Gateway Station
blurb: The Local's home berth, four hundred kilometres up. Everything is available and everything is expensive.

name: Tranquillity Yards
blurb: Lunar orbit. Cheaper to leave than Earth, and the only yard in the inner system that will look at a Kestrel without laughing.

name: Phobos Yard
blurb: A hollowed-out moon with a docking spine bolted through it. Thin margins, thinner air.

name: Ceres Local
blurb: The Belt's crossroads. Half the hulls in dock are older than the crews flying them.
